name: Tan Ming-Kai
intro: A multi-disciplinary designer with 5+ years of experience managing design projects from conceptualisation to finished product.

points: Ran social media accounts and marketing
Managed websites in both design and administration
Designed and executed events projects from start to end product
Designed product packaging and associated social media marketing campaigns
Developed new brand identity of subsidiary companies
Product photographer and videographer for various media
Responsible for designing print and digital graphic content for social events for companies such as Samsung and Hyundai
Liaised directly with company representatives and vendors
Part of a team of 3 responsible for creating designs for advertising in both print and digital media
Liaised between departments for logistics and administration

bio: He's drawn to problems that need solving, ideas worth exploring, and the little details that make things click.
Outside of design, he spends his time immersed in hard sci-fi, and occasionally reading a book while listening to the audiobook at the same time (yes, simultaneously).
He also loves cats, sandbox games, and asking hard questions.
Curiosity is never wasted, and there's always something worth exploring.
Ming also hates writing about himself.
